svg.aria-label: Diagram of the Mintmark pipeline. Declared inputs, a pack pinned by digest with a recipe, a seed, and an identifier policy, enter a deterministic mint that uses no model, no network, no floating point, and no transcendental function. The mint produces sealed output: data files, a label sidecar per document type, a provenance manifest, and checksums. Two commands close the loop: verify recomputes every checksum and re-extracts every span, and reproduce re-mints from the manifest alone and compares byte for byte, returning to the same declared inputs.
svg.title: The Mintmark pipeline
svg.desc: Declared inputs feed a deterministic mint whose output is sealed by a manifest, and two commands re-derive and compare it.
